posts.name: Anubis
posts.cooked: So I made a lot of heroes and seems everyone started pbp games without me noticing. So anyone want to host a game on RG or Discord? I have like eight characters I made for fun so long as you tell me where you're going with the campaign I can make anything really. I do have an idea however if any GM wants suggestions. Tiger and Bunny. In the series it's a world like SC where heroes are everywhere but there is a major difference heroes are treated like celebrities in a reality competition. Each 'officiated' hero has a sponsor and battles bad guys to rank up in popularity until the best hero is chosen at end of each week. I think it be a great setting to explore the darker realities of being a hero as the PCs struggle to do what's right and do what gets them points for the contest.
